methodology.network: loopback HTTP server in a separate interpreter; no accounts or external requests
methodology.paint_instrumentation: dialog and active canvas only, no application-wide event filter
methodology.open: call through real show_preferences to first dialog paint
methodology.form_ready: first queued form interaction, including a deliberate 15ms timer
methodology.close: real Cancel/Save through native event-loop deletion, next calendar paint and heartbeat
methodology.deletion: return to QObject.destroyed notification; following paint/heartbeat also awaited
methodology.sync_cycle: heartbeat and refresh observer remains active through publication and following calendar paint
methodology.sync_overlap: start after full HTTP body served; require real engine job still active
methodology.profiles: timings are unprofiled; no historical query pages or warmup loops
